records.title: UltraScale Architecture and Product Data Sheet: Overview
records.locator: DS891 v1.9 p.8 Table 5 (XCZU5EV total Block RAM 5,184 KB, total UltraRAM 18,432 KB) against DS890 p.22 Table 23 block counts; arithmetic: 5184 / 144 = 36; 18432 / 64 = 288; 144 * 36 / 1024 = 5.0625; 64 * 288 / 1024 = 18.0; 288 * 288 / 1024 = 81.0

One row across the family does not reconcile: ZU3TEG's 48 URAM blocks against its printed 14.0 Mb would imply a 298 Kb tile.
